title: Join Mixpanel Data & Donuts Melbourne Workshop for Expert Funnel and Tracking Support
summary: Want to make sure you’re getting every bit of value out of Mixpanel? We’re hosting Data & Donuts Melbourne, an in-person, workshop-style session built specifically for our local customer community. Whether you want to fine-tune your retention funnels or clean up your tracking plan, our Mixpanel experts will be in the room to walk through your setup with you side-by-side. 🍩 Coffee and breakfast provided. 💻 Laptop required. 🎟️ Grab your spot before seats fill up: events.mixpanel.com/register/dndmel-aug26 (https://events.mixpanel.com/register/dndmel-aug26/) See you there!
